ui_stack: Local-first read-only inspection and dry-run planning

automation.model_runtime: operator-configured; not invoked by this workflow

quality_gates: Read-only and dry-run driver workflow regression tests
success_metrics: no driver installation or firmware writes from GUI auto-actions
package bytes remain local unless explicitly exported by user
motion and theme settings survive invalid input safely
all high-impact operations require explicit confirmation
implementation_boundary: OPlague handles driver package inspection and compatibility planning. The UI must preserve read-only inspection and dry-run defaults. No automatic driver installation, firmware writes, kernel changes or transmission of package contents to external models.
